Plot coverage by region

Source: R/plot.coverage.R
plot.cd_coverage.Rd

Generates a bar chart comparing indicator coverage across regions, highlighting a specific region and categorizing performance as lower, average, or higher.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_coverage'
plot(
  x,
  indicator = NULL,
  denominator = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  ...,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Data frame containing the coverage data.

indicator

Character string specifying the indicator (e.g., 'penta1').

denominator

Character string specifying the denominator ('penta1', 'anc1', 'dhis2', 'penta1derived', 'anc1derived').

year

Integer representing the year to plot.

region

Character string for the specific region to highlight in yellow.

title

The chart's title.

subtitle

The line under the title.

caption

The note under the chart.

x_title

The title of the horizontal axis.

y_title

The title of the vertical axis.

legend_title

The title of the legend.

...

Chart options by name (see cd_chart_options()): background, fonts, sizes, axes, grid, legend, colours. Other arguments are ignored.

legend_labels

(Optional) Named list to override the default category labels (e.g., list(lower = "Low", average = "Avg", higher = "High")).

options

A cd_chart_options() object or a list of chart options: a look made once, to give to several charts. Applied after the text arguments, so a text it holds wins over them.

Value

A ggplot object with the chart options applied: one bar per unit for the selected year, ordered by coverage and coloured by category (the lower, middle and upper third of the values).

Examples

cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$set_national_estimates(list(sbr = 0.02))
cache$adjust_data()
coverage <- cache$calculate_coverage("adminlevel_1")

# `region` is the unit drawn in yellow
plot(coverage, indicator = "penta3", denominator = "penta1", year = 2023, region = "Nairobi")
#> Warning: Removed 7 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_col()`).

plot(coverage, indicator = "penta3", denominator = "penta1", year = 2023, region = "Nairobi",
     title = "Penta3 coverage by region, 2023", y_title = "Coverage (%)",
     legend_labels = list(lower = "Lowest third", average = "Middle third", higher = "Highest third"))
#> Warning: Removed 7 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_col()`).
